answers.goal: My ultimate goal in pursuing a career entertainment is to find a role that combines my interest in partnerships, marketing, and potentially A&R. I’m still exploring which path is best to fit for me in my internship at UMG this summer has given me an incredible opportunity to connect with professionals across many different departments. One area that stands out to me is international marketing. I am fascinated by the challenge of bringing a product or an artist to audiences around the world and developing strategies that resonate across different cultures and markets. Whether it’s working on the global rollout of an artist or helping expand the reach of brand, I’m excited by the opportunity to combine creativity, strategy, and relationship building within the entertainment industry.
answers.drew: Having grown up overseas in Abu Dhabi and Saudi Arabia, I’ve always been interested in the role of media, specifically music, in shaping culture and community. Living as an expat initially drew me to the entertainment industry as it allowed me to connect with my peers and learn about the world around me through creativity. Between concerts, festivals, or even album drops, music has allowed me to feel a sense of belonging and that is something I hope to foster within others as I drive into the industry.
answers.seeking: Add this event I’m hoping to connect with people who are genuinely passionate about what they do and are excited to share their experiences in the entertainment industry. I love learning about the different paths people have taken, the challenges they overcome, and the advice they have for someone who is exploring where they fit in the industry.  I would love to speak with professionals who aren’t afraid to take unconventional approaches to marketing, and think outside the box. I would also love to hear from people who are able to develop creative campaigns that cut through the noise and connect with audiences and authentic ways in this media filled age.
answers.inspiration: One of my biggest inspirations is Tyler, The Creator because of the unconventional way he’s built his career and brand rather than relying on traditional marketing. He’s created the entire ecosystem through ventures like Camp Flog Gnaw and Golf Wang, turning his music into a broader cultural experience. In fact, I’m currently completing a case study on Tyler for my internship at UMG and it’s giving me even greater appreciation for how creative vision and innovative marketing strategies have redefined artist branding.
